display.purpose: The hero title only; two balanced lines. The tile avatar initial borrows this voice.

headline.purpose: Section heads on every landing sheet; the close steps up one size.

title.purpose: Room panel heading; list heads at 18px and key terms at 17px are the smaller steps.

lede.purpose: Hero lede at 62ch; sheet intros at 16px and 40ch.

body.purpose: Landing prose and explanatory content; current layout and sizes are documented in DESIGN.md.

body-compact.purpose: Room chat and transcript rows, inputs, settings copy.

caption.purpose: Live captions on the stage; tile captions are 13px at 580.

button.purpose: Primary and secondary buttons at 730; inherits 1rem.

chrome.purpose: 10px Jost labels on room-header buttons, transport buttons, caption-status pill, people count (640-700).

notation.purpose: Azeret Mono for codes, compact labels, file metadata, the meeting timer and code/plain-text content.

code.purpose: The room-code input at 0.18em; the header room code is 600 at 0.13em.

shadows.name: room-panel
shadows.purpose: The indigo room-entry card in the hero.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: The settings dialog over its rgba(8,10,24,.74) scrim with 6px blur.

shadows.name: weft-pass
shadows.purpose: Each caption's thread as it crosses the warps, so the cloth reads as cloth.

shadows.name: speaking-ring
shadows.purpose: A two-step ring in the tile's thread colour; inner 1.5-4px at .42-.92, outer 3.5-10px at .08-.30, driven by voice level. Reduced motion: solid 3px at .9.

shadows.name: leaving-scrim
shadows.purpose: Full-screen scrim while local media is released.

shadows.name: omni-active
shadows.purpose: Steady operational glow while Omni prepares, awaits approval or speaks; not a confidence display.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: The one easing for every authored movement: picks, wefts, notes, the advance, the speaking ring.

motion.name: pick-interval
motion.purpose: A new caption row arrives on the draft every 1.9s while the tab is visible; paused when document.hidden.

motion.name: weft-in
motion.purpose: The weft draws in left to right across the warps.

motion.name: note-in
motion.purpose: The speaker tag and caption slide in after the weft.

motion.name: draft-advance
motion.purpose: Once seven picks show, the list moves up one pick height while the oldest row fades over 360ms ease-out, then the row is dropped.

motion.name: speaking-ring
motion.purpose: The thread ring on a tile fades in and out with voice activity.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation-duration .01ms; animation-iteration-count 1; draft static at 7 picks, never advances

breakpoints.name: landing-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Hero and sections stack; invite visitors see the room panel before the illustrative draft.

breakpoints.name: landing-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Navigation links hide while Settings remains; hero uses clamp(38px, 11vw, 56px), with 16px gutters.

breakpoints.name: room-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Stage and side panel stack; normal panels use up to 45vh. Active Muse moves above the stage and uses up to 75dvh.

breakpoints.name: room-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Video and room chrome compress, labels hide and settings-dialog padding becomes 16px.

breakpoints.name: room-tiny
breakpoints.purpose: The brand hides from the room header.

breakpoints.name: preview-phone
breakpoints.purpose: File preview becomes a full-screen modal.

narrative.overview: The Weaver’s Draft connects an agent-native meeting app to its visual identity. Indigo surfaces frame cotton text and human thread colors; the landing illustrates a conversation as a weave. The room combines video, screen sharing, public records, a private Muse panel and Omni’s status/approval card. The shared Excalidraw board is a light editing canvas within that indigo frame. DESIGN.md describes the current interface, PRODUCT.md describes current behavior, and GROUPTHINK.md describes automatic Omni review.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo ground and panels, cotton copy, thin rules and restrained elevation.
Gold for primary actions, focus and active state; cotton secondary controls and Muse composer actions.
Human thread colors for speaker identity; neutral assistant speech with explicit attribution.
Jost for interface prose and headings; Azeret Mono for functional notation, timer and code/text content.
An explicitly illustrative woven conversation and interactive SVG board example on the landing.
A light Excalidraw canvas for shared human and agent editing.
Private reminder cards stay silent; Omni prepares silently and requires approval before public speech.

rules.name: Action and identity
rules.body: Use gold for primary actions, focus and selection, and the existing neutral treatment for secondary controls and Muse Send. Human colors identify speakers; assistant transcripts use explicit names and neutral cotton.

rules.name: State color
rules.body: Coral marks muted/off states, Leave and errors. Verdigris marks live captions and active sharing. Omni’s steady gold glow accompanies preparing, approval and speech states, never a person or confidence score.

rules.name: Functional typography
rules.body: Use Jost for prose, headings and controls. Use Azeret Mono for codes, compact notation, file metadata, the meeting timer and code/plain-text previews. Display headings remain medium weight.

rules.name: Illustration and work
rules.body: Keep graph paper on the illustrative draft. Use the light Excalidraw canvas and its existing green controls for the shared board. Do not imply the illustrative payment flow is a live meeting artifact.

rules.name: Invite ordering
rules.body: Below 1080px an invite places the room form ahead of the draft; on desktop the room panel sits beside the hero copy.

rules.name: Audience and approval
rules.body: Private Muse dialogue, requested shared board edits, requested Room messages and approved public speech have separate boundaries. Omni’s Room card offers approval; its speech appears in Transcript. No Insights panel or participant profile is implemented.

rules.name: Truthful disclosure
rules.body: Describe participant WebRTC/TURN, direct AI connections, Worker processing and local recovery storage separately. Do not claim the Worker never receives transcript text, all traffic stays in-browser, or automatic reminders can be paused in the current interface.

dos: Use the colors, sizes and interaction states in the current DESIGN.md and rendering stylesheets.
Preserve explicit human and assistant attribution in public records.
Keep native labels, visible keyboard focus, accessible selected state and usable modal previews.
Preserve the alternating warp/weft crossings and the labelled synthetic conversation.
Honor reduced motion: freeze the woven draft and reduce operational animation.
Show transfer progress, missing context and provider errors when those states occur.
Keep private reminder cards silent and collapsible after 15 visible seconds; retain evidence in Muse.
Show Omni preparation, approval, quiet-waiting and speech as distinct states.
donts: Do not fabricate testimonials, metrics, customers or validated detection outcomes.
Do not use a speaker color as a diagnosis or score.
Do not claim future charts or removed controls exist.
Do not conflate a Room post with reading one approved message aloud.
Do not treat shared context or an available tool as permission to mutate shared work.
Do not place private conversations in public replay or imply partial recovery is a complete archive.
